endorsements.name: Adrien Thierry
endorsements.label: CVE-2012-10064
endorsements.description: Omni Secure Files plugin versions prior to 0.1.14 contain an arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the bundled plupload example endpoint. The /wp-content/plugins/omni-secure-files/plupload/examples/upload.php handler allows unauthenticated uploads without enforcing safe file type restrictions, enabling an attacker to place attacker-controlled files under the plugin's uploads directory. This can lead to remote code execution if a server-executable file type is uploaded and subsequently accessed.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.3)
